scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: The result is derived analytically from the boundary moment constraints and a nonnegative derivative measure; no numerical enumeration is used as proof.
limitations: The minimum-TV theorem is restricted to nondecreasing controls.
No claim is made for global TV optimality among nonmonotone bounded controls.
The combined energy-plus-TV objective is not analyzed.

title: Exact saturation law for monotone minimum-variation double-integrator controls
